title: s11-drift-notes
description:
S11 pre-design (docs-only; IMAGE_STAB_PLAN.md deliberately untouched
- single-writer discipline; the owner folds approved parts into the
plan). Grounded in the 2026-11-24 night measurements (branch
s-measure-handheld: /tmp/yurumek.ristab, /tmp/yavas_pan.ristab,
/tmp/elde_sabit.ristab) plus a throwaway desktop simulation that was
run and deleted per the brief.

Key findings folded into the seven design items:

- Drift origin is NOT lost pairs (their stored values are zero, the
  velocity-hold inserts at most 2 frames): it is the Ok pairs'
  systematic logS bias (+0.0122 mean on the walk clip), i.e. walking
  parallax that the free 4-DOF similarity absorbs as per-pair scale
  and the composition accumulates exponentially (exp ~ 18007x).
  Pan and steady-hand clips carry no such bias (+0.0004 / ~0).
- Banded |logS| clamps do not fix it (S=0.005 still accumulates to
  28.7x; the bias sits in
